verdict.rationale: Codegen's PRs, branches, and agent run logs/traces provide some inherent versioning and review via GitHub PR workflow and agent trace retrieval, but there is no evidence of a dedicated automation versioning system, rollback/undo mechanism for agent-made changes, or an automation change-history UI. missing for 10: explicit version history for automations/agent configs, a rollback or revert mechanism beyond git PR revert, review workflow specific to 'automations' (vs code changes), and any UI/CLI command for restoring prior automation states.
